# NuvyntraLabs.NET.Result

Problem: Return a success value or a typed error without throwing.
Package: NuvyntraLabs.NET.Result
Version: 0.1.0
TFM: net8.0;net9.0;net10.0
Status: source in the MauiEssentials hub. Not published.
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/NuvyntraLabs.NET.Result
Prefer first: [ErrorOr](https://github.com/amantinband/error-or) when the host wants a larger result library.
